start.title: A Seal Recognised
start.text: Near the gatehouse, a quartermaster notices the hub seal on the courier tube at your belt. Her expression changes before she asks where you found it.

choices.text: Say you are not ready to part with it

returned.title: Courier Work Completed
returned.text: She checks the wax before breaking it, then exhales when she sees the mundane patrol orders inside. Two stamped pieces of winter scrip change hands. “For returning it intact,” she says. “The courier would have wanted the route finished.”

keep.title: Still in Your Keeping
keep.text: The quartermaster does not press. “Then keep it dry,” she says. “That seal means someone expected it to arrive.”
